```plato

// Sample quantiles as parallel arrays: Values[i] is the data value at
// cumulative probability Levels[i] (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Quantile).
// Levels ascend and lie in [0, 1].
type Quantiles
    implements IValue
{
    Levels: Array<Probability>;
    Values: Array<Number>;
}
```
